publicSensitivity: source, internal execution records, screenshots, fixture paths, command output and local workspace identities; publication not yet authorized
excluded: incidental private system-menu AX raw, scratch fixture bundles and generated build outputs
calibration: Raw empirical/log/manifest evidence is not treated as a new prose judgment solely because it is published; operative rationale entries retain their own attribution and review requirements. Classification is not an exhaustive secret scan.
